title: Amblyopia (Lazy Eye) Status Summary (Developmental adaptation to unilateral visual impairment*)
group: AME PHYSICAL EXAMINATION INFORMATION AND DISPOSITION TABLES

blocks.text: Please have your ophthalmologist or optometrist provide the requested information in the space provided. Submit this summary or a current, detailed Clinical Progress Note addressing each item. Attach a copy of any additional testing already performed and submit all items to your AME for upload into your FAA file:

blocks.text: - 1. Does this individual have any ophthalmological diagnosis OTHER than a stable, non-progressive childhood condition (such as mild refractive, strabismus, or juvenile/congenital amblyopia, or developmental adaptation to unilateral visual impairment*)?

blocks.text: - 2. Does this condition affect BOTH eyes or is there any non-refractive issue that could compromise vision in the better eye?

*This status summary can be used for decreased vision caused by a process strictly limited to one eye, with a fully normal fellow eye, and an onset less than age 12 and consistent with developmental adaptation.
